methods.name: evolution.diff
methods.description: Compare public changes between two immutable States.
typeDefinitions: type JsonPrimitive = boolean | null | number | string;
type JsonValue = JsonPrimitive | JsonObject | JsonValue[];

type ObjectKind =
  | "domain"
  | "node-definition"
  | "relationship-definition"
  | "knowledge-node"
  | "knowledge-relationship";
methods.example: return await evolution.diff({ before: "<base-state>", after: "<target-state>", scope: "all" });
notes: scope is all, ontology, knowledge, or object. For object scope, supply an object filter with anchorState and ref.

methods.name: evolution.get

typeDefinitions: type JsonPrimitive = boolean | null | number | string;

methods.name: evolution.history
methods.description: Read public changes reachable from a State with scope filtering.
typeDefinitions: type JsonPrimitive = boolean | null | number | string;
type JsonValue = JsonPrimitive | JsonObject | JsonValue[];

type ObjectKind =
  | "domain"
  | "node-definition"
  | "relationship-definition"
  | "knowledge-node"
  | "knowledge-relationship";
methods.example: return await evolution.history({ root: "branch/main", scope: "all", limit: 20 });
notes: scope is all, ontology, knowledge, or object. For object scope, supply an object filter with anchorState and ref.

methods.name: evolution.merge.abort
methods.description: Abort an unfinished Merge Session at its current revision.
methods.example: const s = await evolution.merge.get({ session: "<session-id>" }); return await evolution.merge.abort({ session: s.session, expectedRevision: s.revision });
notes: Example identifiers and revision numbers are placeholders; replace them with verified, authorized targets before executing.
Use the observed Merge Session revision. Aborting a Session does not undo previous commits.

methods.name: evolution.merge.finalize
methods.description: Finalize a Merge Session using its current revision; may fast-forward or create a Commit.
methods.example: const s = await evolution.merge.get({ session: "<session-id>" }); return await evolution.merge.finalize({ session: s.session, expectedRevision: s.revision });
notes: Example identifiers and revision numbers are placeholders; replace them with verified, authorized targets before executing.
Use the observed Merge Session revision. The Session may be stale after other changes.

methods.name: evolution.merge.get
methods.description: Read the current status and revision of a Merge Session.

methods.name: evolution.merge.list
methods.description: List Merge Sessions with optional pagination.

methods.name: evolution.merge.resolve
methods.description: Apply conflict resolutions using the observed Session revision.
typeDefinitions: type JsonPrimitive = boolean | null | number | string;
type JsonValue = JsonPrimitive | JsonObject | JsonValue[];
methods.example: const s = await evolution.merge.get({ session: "<session-id>" }); return await evolution.merge.resolve({ session: s.session, expectedRevision: s.revision, resolutions: [{ conflictId: "<conflict-id>", choice: "ours" }] });
notes: Example identifiers and revision numbers are placeholders; replace them with verified, authorized targets before executing.
Use the current Merge Session revision, and choose resolutions based on the observed conflicts; 'ours' is only an illustrative choice.

methods.name: graph.execute
methods.description: Execute Cypher on a writable Branch; its effect depends on the statement.
typeDefinitions: type JsonPrimitive = boolean | null | number | string;
type JsonValue = JsonPrimitive | JsonObject | JsonValue[];
methods.example: return await graph.execute({ branch: "<target-branch>", cypher: "MATCH (n) RETURN count(n) AS count" });
notes: Example identifiers and revision numbers are placeholders; replace them with verified, authorized targets before executing.
Cypher is passed through unchanged. Calling execute does not guarantee that a new Commit is created.

methods.name: graph.query
methods.description: Execute a read-only Cypher query at a State.
typeDefinitions: type JsonPrimitive = boolean | null | number | string;
type JsonValue = JsonPrimitive | JsonObject | JsonValue[];
methods.example: return await graph.query({ at: "branch/main", cypher: "MATCH (n) RETURN n LIMIT 10" });

methods.name: graph.streamExecute
methods.description: Stream Cypher execution on a writable Branch.
typeDefinitions: type GraphStreamEvent = GraphColumnsEvent | GraphRowEvent | GraphSummaryEvent;
type JsonPrimitive = boolean | null | number | string;
type JsonValue = JsonPrimitive | JsonObject | JsonValue[];
methods.example: const events = []; for await (const event of graph.streamExecute({ branch: "<target-branch>", cypher: "MATCH (n) RETURN count(n)" })) events.push(event); return events;
notes: Example identifiers and revision numbers are placeholders; replace them with verified, authorized targets before executing.
Rows or columns alone do not confirm success; inspect the terminal summary or error.

methods.name: graph.streamQuery
methods.description: Stream read-only Cypher columns, rows, and final summary.
typeDefinitions: type GraphStreamEvent = GraphColumnsEvent | GraphRowEvent | GraphSummaryEvent;
type JsonPrimitive = boolean | null | number | string;
type JsonValue = JsonPrimitive | JsonObject | JsonValue[];
methods.example: const rows = []; for await (const event of graph.streamQuery({ at: "branch/main", cypher: "MATCH (n) RETURN n LIMIT 10" })) { if (event.type === "row") rows.push(event.row); } return rows;

methods.name: object.patch
methods.description: Atomically apply a Git Extended Diff spanning public Objects.
typeDefinitions:
type ObjectKind =
  | "domain"
  | "node-definition"
  | "relationship-definition"
  | "knowledge-node"
  | "knowledge-relationship";
methods.example: return await object.patch({ branch: "<target-branch>", baseState: "<observed-base-state>", patch: "<git-extended-diff>" });
notes: Example identifiers and revision numbers are placeholders; replace them with verified, authorized targets before executing.
Use the observed baseState and canonical editable Object text to construct the patch.
